why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Cedric Mullins is slot #6 (4.416 expected team runs/game).
Slots #6, #3, #7, #5, #4, #8, #2, #1, #9 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #7 ranks 3 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.002 R/G.
Slot #6 yields 4.14 expected PA/game vs 4.03 at primary slot #7. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
Offensive profile group: Balanced (exploratory unsupervised cluster — not a definitive archetype).
Cleanup (#4) models +0.000 R/G vs his average placement — typically less value than mid/lower-order spots when power/run-production profiles are modest relative to the nine.
